findings.claim: 10-K 列出 Surgerii、CMR、Distalmotion、Medicaroid、Medtronic、J&J、Noah、微創醫療機器人、SS Innovations 等為已推出或明確進入機器人手術的對手，並預期中國競爭加劇；2025 年中國競爭與反貪腐使裝機少於預期
findings.excerpt: In 2025, the effects of this campaign, combined with the competitive dynamics in China and various measures related to industrial policy, contributed to fewer systems being placed in China than we anticipated.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 財報電話會議：管理層稱中國招標減少、本土機器人競爭增加、政策導向降價壓力
findings.source: Webull：Intuitive Surgical Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
findings.excerpt: We continue to see lower tender activity, increased domestic robotic competition, and policy-driven pricing pressure.

findings.claim: Q1 2026 da Vinci 5 占美國系統裝機 85%，作者認為在 Medtronic Hugo、J&J Ottava 站穩美國前先鎖定醫院預算
findings.source: Yahoo Finance：ISRG just secured U.S. market
findings.excerpt: The da Vinci 5 (dV5) accounted for 85% of U.S. system placements in Q1 2026. This rapid adoption secures hospital capital budgets before Medtronic's (MDT) Hugo or Johnson & Johnson's (JNJ) Ottava can establish a significant U.S. foothold.

note: Hugo 2025-12 取得 FDA 泌尿適應症、Ottava 2026 取得 FDA de novo（來自搜尋摘要，未逐字取得）；市占數字各來源不一致，未採用。as_of 為估計日。
